blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two Filipinos were injured in an attack at an international airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on Saturday, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Cacdac said Sunday. Cacdac said teams from the Migrant Workers Office and the Overseas Workers Welfare Administration were monitoring the condition of the two Filipinos. “As of 11 a.m. today PHL time, two Filipinos are in Riyadh hospital ICUs [intensive care unit], recovering from their injuries as a result of yesterday’s attacks on King Khalid International Airport,” Cacdac said in a post on X.
